title: Austin: Dedicate a Day to Transit
summary:
*   City officials will attend a press conference launching a CapMetro initiative.
*   The initiative challenges the community to dedicate one day a week to using public transit.
*   This meeting is for the announcement only; no policy actions or decisions will be made.
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
THURSDAY, APRIL 25, 2019 
CITY HALL PLAZA 
301 W. SECOND STREET 
AUSTIN, TX 78701 
 
Press Conference 
 
9:00 AM 
Attend a press conference announcing a CapMetro transit initiative to challenge our 
community to dedicate one day a week to transit.  
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
